data.text:
S N Consultant vs Deputy Commissioner Of Customs & Anr on 
22 July, 2024 
Author: Yashwant Varma
Bench: Yashwant Varma
 $~10
 * In The High Court Of Delhi At New Delhi
 + W.P.(C) 7728/2024
 S N Consultant 
 Through: 
 
 
 
 versus
 Deputy Commissioner Of Customs
 & Anr. .....Respondents 
 Through: 
 
 
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Yashwant Varma
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ravinder Dudeja 
 Order 
% 22.07.2024 1. Mr. Singla, learned counsel appearing for the respondent, has drawn our attention to a communication dated 12 July 2024 addressed to the authorized officer of the National Food Laboratory, Food Safety & Standards Authority of India and in terms of which a request has been made to the said authority to designate an officer who may draw samples as per the request of the petitioner which has come to be accepted. It is presently not known as to whether further steps have now been taken in that regard.
2. Bearing in mind the fact that the consignment had been detained This is a digitally signed order. 
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above. The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 25/07/2024 at 21:20:04 in February, 2024, we request the respondents to proceed further with due expedition. 
S N Consultant vs Deputy Commissioner Of Customs & Anr on 22 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/166665416/
1 3. Let this writ petition be called again to review progress on 12.08.2024. 
YASHWANT VARMA, J.
RAVINDER DUDEJA, J.
